script.base: Roof closed, BUF -3.5, total 49.5, implied totals BUF 26.5 / ATL 23.0. Market expects a competitive one-score game, not a blowout, with enough plays for volume. BUF leads late and keeps a run lean through James Cook (56 car / 274 yds over weeks 3-5) while Josh Allen still takes designed runs (17/126). ATL stays live through Bijan Robinson (52/290 rush and 16/170 receiving over weeks 2-4) and has to throw as the +3.5 dog, with Darnell Mooney out so Drake London and Kyle Pitts carry the pass game.
script.flip1: BUF gets up by 10+ early, kills clock with Cook, and ATL abandons the run so Bijan's rush line dies and Tyler Allgeier (33 car / 131 yds in that same three-game window) never gets a script. ATL becomes pass-only and London/Pitts/Bijan receiving absorb the dropbacks.
script.flip2: Dome shootout: both teams throw. ATL's 41% blitz does not stall BUF (EPA/db 0.39 vs blitz vs 0.28 vs none), so Shakir/Coleman and Kincaid if active stay live, ATL matches through London, and Cook's pure rush stalls because BUF does not need to grind.

pre_mortem: It's the morning after and both lost because BUF led by two scores at half, ATL emptied the backfield, Allgeier and checkdowns replaced Bijan's between-the-tackles carries, and he finished in the 24-to-72 band under 73.5. London was held to another 49-55 yard game: Mooney's targets went to Pitts and Bijan screens, BUF bracketed the only healthy outside WR, and the 110-yard game was the outlier the line was already fading. Missing Hamlin did not equal a busted coverage, and with no price we never knew if 55.5 was the sharp side. A Kincaid full-go or a Cook 130-yard clock-kill would also have meant the ATL skill stack was the wrong story.
slip_story: One story only: competitive dome game, ATL skill volume against a BUF defense missing Milano, Hamlin and Sanders. Bijan rush over is the matchup anchor and is script-dependent; London over is the dog-throws / Mooney-sleeper leg that still works if ATL trails. They win together if ATL stays within a score. Do not pair them with a game under, and do not add Cook over — that needs BUF to grind, and 108.5 is already above his 91-yard weeks 3-5 mean. Kincaid left off until inactives. No TDs, no receptions, no passing yards.
